# dnshe_subdomain (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dnshe_subdomain" "record" {
  subdomain  = "xxx"
  rootdomain = "bbroot.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `subdomain` (String)
